title: Low-Carb Nectarine Toast
description: A delicious and easy keto breakfast recipe that combines toasted bread with fresh nectarine slices.

ingredients.name: Turkish Bread
ingredients.notes: Use a low-carb bread alternative or make your own

ingredients.name: Optional: Whipped Cream
ingredients.notes: Add a dollop of whipped cream for extra creaminess

instructions: Toast the Turkish bread until lightly browned.
Spread a pinch of salt on the toasted bread.
Arrange the nectarine slices on top of the bread.
Optional: Add a dollop of whipped cream on top.
